tool_config.name: otkaz_ot_smeny_careline_demo
tool_config.description: Records that the caregiver on the line cannot work a shift and starts the search for a replacement. The caregiver is recognized by the number they are calling from. Call it only after you asked the reason and the caregiver confirmed the weekday, the date and the reason — once per shift. If the result has nuzhno_utochnit true (even with ok false, e.g. kod net_prichiny), nothing is recorded yet: ask what soobshchenie asks and call it again with the answer. Never for a message. If ok is false otherwise, the call-off is NOT recorded — never say it was; take a message. Never promise that the shift will be covered.

data_smeny.description: Date of the shift as YYYY-MM-DD, worked out from today's date and confirmed by the caregiver.

klient_kod.description: Client code only if the caregiver said one, e.g. BK-114. Never a client's name.

prichina.description: Reason in one word, as the caregiver said it when you asked: bolezn (sick), semya (family matter), transport, drugoe (they said something else). Ask before calling — never guess.

yazyk.description: Language of the conversation right now.
